sourceNotes: 命令栏新增文件与文件夹搜索，支持打开、在 Finder 中显示、快速预览及常用文件操作
命令栏新增后台进程查询与结束操作，支持按名称、PID 或端口筛选，结束前确认并重新核验进程身份
减少实时查询、历史数据读取与测速进度更新的资源开销
修复重复启动时出现多个应用实例的问题，将启动请求交由已有实例处理
修复中文时区时间在午夜显示为 24 点的问题
修复 Finder「新建文档」主菜单缺少图标的问题

en: Search for files and folders from the command bar, with open, reveal in Finder, Quick Look, and common file actions. Chinese names support pinyin and initials within a limited scope; file contents are not read.
Find background processes by name, PID, or port and end them from the command bar, with confirmation and a fresh identity check before termination.
Reduce resource overhead from live queries, history reads, and speed test progress updates.
Prevent duplicate app instances by forwarding launch requests to the existing instance.
Fix Chinese time zone clocks showing hour 24 at midnight.
Restore the icon on Finder's New Document parent menu.
